rule.excluded: `important_instructions` on non-test tasks (held out of training and validation); other templates on test tasks
rule.test_episodes: clean runs of test tasks and `important_instructions` attacks on them
rule.val_seed_rule: val_seed = child `subsample` of global seed 0; per (benchmark, suite) the task order is numpy default_rng([val_seed, crc32('<benchmark>/<suite>')]).permutation over the sorted non-test task ids (labels.val_task_ids)

validation.agentdojo: 0.2 of the non-test tasks of each suite, rounded, at least one; order from numpy default_rng([val_seed, crc32('agentdojo/<suite>')]) over the sorted task ids
validation.agentdyn: all non-test tasks: every clean non-test AgentDyn run is threshold validation (splits.contract.agentdyn_clean_non_test = validation, contract §6)
